Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A method, comprising: inputting __at least a portion of__ database constructs generated by a database optimizer as an input to a trained machine-learning algorithm; obtaining a database operation predictor __comprising at least one of an estimated execution time and detected resource cost__ from the machine-learning algorithm as an output; modifying at least one of the database constructs based on the database operation predictor producing a modified database construct; and processing a database operation with the __original one or more__ database constructs and the modified database construct.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1, wherein inputting further includes inputting __at least a portion of__ the database constructs as query execution plans for a query.

Claim 5 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1, wherein obtaining further includes acquiring the database operation predictor as an estimated Central Processing Unit (CPU) execution time __and/or an estimated number of Input/Output (I/O) operations__ for one or more Access Module Processors to execute when processing the database operation.

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1, wherein modifying further includes changing a scheduled execution time for the database operation __and/or the query execution plan as the modified database construct__.

Claim 10 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 further comprising, storing the database operation predictor __and/or statistics derived from it__ in database statistics associated with the database operation and the database constructs.

Claim 12 (Currently Amended): A method comprising: training a machine-learning algorithm with database constructs produced by a database optimizer; receiving query execution plans for a query from the database optimizer __which includes at least a least cost query execution plan__ identified by the database optimizer for the query; providing the query execution plans as input to the machine-learning algorithm; obtaining as an output a predicted execution time for the query based on __at least the least cost query execution plan; and modifying one or more of: the least cost query execution plan for the query, a scheduled execution time for the query, and resources that are used to execute the query based on the predicted execution time.__
